d.d: To make or cause to make a short beeping or blipping sound.
Relating to, or supported by two groups, especially by two political parties.
In the context of a two-party system, especially in the United States, cooperation between the competing political parties; governing in a bipartisan manner.
Having two parts (two principal or main parts).
Divided into two at the base.
An animal, being, or construction that goes about on two feet (or two legs).
Walking on two feet or two legs; biped.
Composed of, or relating to, two planes (flat surfaces extending infinitely in all directions).
Having, or consisting of, two superposed planes, aerocurves, etc.
An airplane that has two main wings, one above the other and supported by struts.
Involving or having both extremes or poles at the same time.
